newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ Natural Gas Corp to pay 24 cent/shr div.
newsitem.headline: NZ Natural Gas Corp to pay 24 cent/shr div.

text.p: New Zealand's Natural Gas Corp on Friday declared a fully-imputed final dividend of 24 cents per share, prior to its announcement of annual results.

The payment will be the last dividend to be paid prior to the maturity of its convertible capital notes (CCN) on October 14, and the early announcement of the dividend was due to the impending maturity of the notes, NGC said.
The final dividend will be paid on August 18 to shareholders on register at the close on August 8.
The company's results for the year ended June 30, 1997, are due on August 21.
